baseline: HUNT Cinematic V16 original scene architecture
baseline_rule: Cinematic first. Stylist intelligence arranges products inside the original scene language; it must never replace the experience with a generic ecommerce grid.

stylist_mapping.hero: One focal product only; chosen by style coherence + product truth + display fit. Commercial gate may still block promotion.
stylist_mapping.rail: Supporting pieces from the same look, ordered by visual relationship rather than raw catalog order.
stylist_mapping.complete_the_look: Complementary products only; no unrelated filler.
stylist_mapping.discovery_stream: Broader exploration after the core look, preserving category/taste context.

hard_rules: Never use current HUNT shelf order as training truth when availability verification is weak.
Do not promote a high-shipping product to commercial Hero solely because it improves the look.
Do not darken product photography in dark mode.
Light mode remains warm off-white, never clinical pure white.
One dominant focal product per scene.
Exact Printful artwork/mockups remain required before final visual approval.
No Production shelf reorder or publish from this integration.
